business_process: Production scheduling and work order release
description: Finite-capacity schedule in the APS; work orders released from the ERP to the MES; electronic travelers on shop-floor kiosks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: MES holds about 2 shifts of released work orders; beyond 48 hours the plant runs out of released work and storm-order slots slip; ERP database point-in-time restore supports a 4-hour RPO
manual_workaround: Printed 5-day schedule refreshed daily; paper travelers from the traveler kit; Production Planning Manager releases work by whiteboard
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; internet carrier; ERP software vendor (support)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production planners; shift supervisors; plant server room

description: 2 CNC core cutting lines and 14 coil winding machines run PLC programs and per-order winding recipes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 3 days of cut cores and wound coils are buffered ahead of assembly; each lost day costs about $336,000 of shipments; recipes change with each order so a 24-hour RPO is needed
manual_workaround: Manual recipe entry at the winder HMI from printed winding sheets (slower; engineering double-check); core line runs stored programs locally
dependent_third_parties: Winding machine and core line OEMs
dependent_people_or_facilities: Winding and core operators; Controls Engineer; Bay A and Bay B

description: Vapor-phase drying oven, 2 conventional ovens, and the vacuum oil fill station dry insulation and fill every transformer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every power transformer and large distribution unit must be dried and oil filled; an interrupted drying cycle must restart; loss of control integrity is a worker safety hazard (heat, vacuum, oil); RPO is the last approved recipe and PLC program
manual_workaround: Ovens can run stored recipes from the local PLC with the HMI offline; safe shutdown procedure if HMI integrity is in doubt; no manual drying possible
dependent_people_or_facilities: Oven operators; Controls Engineer; oil processing area

description: CNC plasma cutting and 2 robotic welding cells build tanks and covers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tank shop runs about 1 week ahead of assembly; tanks can be bought from an outside fabricator in an emergency
manual_workaround: Manual welding for simple tanks; outside fabricator for standard pad-mount tanks
dependent_third_parties: Welding cell OEM; outside tank fabricator

business_process: Final assembly, high-voltage testing, and certified test reports
description: Core-coil assembly, tanking, and routine tests (ratio, resistance, losses, applied and induced voltage, impulse for power units); Quality signs certified test reports; TMU firmware and configuration loaded
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No transformer ships without a certified test report; utilities and the federal contract require them; test data integrity is part of product integrity; each test takes hours so losing data means retesting
manual_workaround: Test systems can run offline and store results locally; Quality hand-signs reports from raw data printouts; retest when data integrity is in doubt
dependent_third_parties: Test equipment OEM; TMU electronics supplier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Test technicians; Quality Manager; high-voltage test bay

business_process: Order entry, quoting, and design engineering
description: Customer specifications, electromagnetic design, drawings, and bills of materials in the PLM vault and CAD workstations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders in production already have released designs; new quotes and designs can wait about 3 days; PLM is backed up nightly
manual_workaround: Quote from standard price book; hold new designs; engineers work from released drawings in the traveler kit

description: Purchase orders for core steel, copper, oil, bushings, and TMUs; receiving; inventory
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Key materials have long lead times; about 2 weeks of stock on hand; ERP point-in-time restore supports 4 hours
manual_workaround: Phone and email orders to top 10 suppliers; manual receiving log

description: Bills of lading, export screening, heavy-haul permits and carrier scheduling for power transformers, delivery to utilities and the federal site
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Heavy-haul moves are booked weeks ahead and are costly to reschedule; export screening records must be kept 5 years (15 CFR 762.6)
manual_workaround: Paper bills of lading; manual screening through the government consolidated screening list website; hold export shipments until the ERP is back

business_process: Field service, TMU support, and storm response
description: Commissioning, repairs, and storm-response crews; TMU configuration support; notices owed to utilities under the addenda
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Utilities rely on storm-response crews; addendum duties (48-hour incident notice, 1-business-day access notice) keep running during an outage; needs phones, laptops, and the TMU library
manual_workaround: Phones and printed contact list; field laptops work offline; TMU library copy on a verified offline drive
dependent_third_parties: Utilities' remote access systems; TMU electronics supplier

description: Invoicing, collections, payables, biweekly payroll, onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly in the payroll SaaS; invoices can be delayed a few days; terminations must still be processed same day
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; manual invoices; HR emails IT and Field Service for terminations
